summary: Accelerating the discovery of new treatments for infectious diseases in the Global South is a pressing concern. The Ersilia Model Hub addresses this issue by providing a unified platform of pre-trained AI/ML models for infectious and neglected disease research. This open-source platform offers seamless access to AI/ML models for drug discovery, aiming to equip laboratories, universities, and clinics in the Global South with AI/ML tools. The project's beneficiaries are primarily researchers and healthcare professionals in low-income countries and rural areas. The Ersilia Model Hub operates in the context of infectious disease research, with a focus on neglected tropical diseases. This platform has the potential to improve healthcare outcomes and reduce the burden of infectious diseases in vulnerable populations.
